description: This Java class defines a supervisor actor for managing publication-related actors in an Akka-based system. It handles creation of publisher and updater actors, manages their lifecycle, and routes publication messages.

classes.name: PubSupervisor
classes.description: An Akka actor that supervises actors involved in publishing, managing their lifecycle, and routing messages.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration for this actor with given DData.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Defines the receive behavior for handling publish messages and publisher availability.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a child actor fails.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Initializes and starts child actors for publishing and data updates.

methods.name: isPublisherAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the publisher actor reference is available.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Sends a publication message to the publisher actor.

methods.name: publisherUnavailable
methods.description: Logs an error when the publisher actor is unavailable.
